## Source Modules

- [binance.async_client](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/async_client.py): Create a listenToken for margin account user data stream
- [binance.base_client](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/base_client.py)
- [binance.enums](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/enums.py)
- [binance.exceptions](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/exceptions.py): Raised when the websocket message queue exceeds its maximum size.
- [binance.helpers](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/helpers.py): Convert UTC date to milliseconds
- [binance.ws.constants](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/ws/constants.py)
- [binance.ws.depthcache](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/ws/depthcache.py): Add a bid to the cache
- [binance.ws.keepalive_websocket](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/ws/keepalive_websocket.py): Override connect to handle ws_api subscriptions differently.
- [binance.ws.reconnecting_websocket](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/ws/reconnecting_websocket.py)
- [binance.ws.streams](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/ws/streams.py): Start a websocket for symbol market depth returning either a diff or a partial book
- [binance.ws.threaded_stream](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/ws/threaded_stream.py)
- [binance.ws.websocket_api](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/binance/ws/websocket_api.py): Register a queue to receive events for a specific subscription.
- [code-generator](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/code-generator.py): Fetch endpoints from the provided Binance doc URLs, filtering duplicates.
- [docs.conf](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/docs/conf.py)
- [examples.binace_socket_manager](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/binace_socket_manager.py)
- [examples.create_oco_order](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/create_oco_order.py)
- [examples.create_order](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/create_order.py)
- [examples.create_order_async](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/create_order_async.py)
- [examples.depth_cache_example](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/depth_cache_example.py)
- [examples.depth_cache_threaded_example](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/depth_cache_threaded_example.py)
- [examples.futures_algo_order_examples](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/futures_algo_order_examples.py): Create a basic STOP_MARKET algo order
- [examples.save_historical_data](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/save_historical_data.py): Convert UTC date to milliseconds
- [examples.websocket](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/websocket.py)
- [examples.ws_create_order](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/ws_create_order.py)
- [examples.ws_create_order_async](https://github.com/sammchardy/python-binance/blob/master/examples/ws_create_order_async.py)
